# stream sensor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:streamSensor`](gmeow-streamSensor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/streamSensor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

The specific sensor or agent producing the stream. Non-functional: multiple sensors may contribute to one stream, and competing sensor claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
